implementation_strategy: Execute preregistered paired experiment using the hosted_netops_gvr_v1 adapter: (1) deterministic synthetic topology + intent generator (seed=42) produces 200 tasks; (2) for each task run two pipelines using gpt-5-mini via openai_responses: baseline (one LLM call) and guarded (one LLM call plus deterministic in-Docker verifier/simulator checks); (3) deterministic automated scoring performed by the published sandbox verifier (Docker, CPU); (4) all artifacts, hashes, and logs archived; (5) follow preregistered exclusion, retry (up to 1), and stopping rules. No human scientific labour, manual adjudication, or external/private resources are used.
task_manifest_strategy: Deterministic synthetic topology and prompt generator (public code artifact) seeded with RNG seed=42 to yield 200 unique tasks; two condition variants (benign/adversarial) per task generated by templated rule set. Duplicate-prompt detection via prompt-hash triggers automatic deterministic replacement from next seed.
transformation_manifest_strategy: Deterministic transformation pipeline: prompt templating -> canonical intent -> vendor-agnostic AST (JSON) -> serialized config. Round-trip AST equality checks and 20 preregistered unit tests enforce transformation correctness; failures trigger automatic exclusion+replacement.
randomisation_plan: All randomness is deterministic from preregistered RNG seed=42. Task generation, audit-sample selection, and any stochastic sampling are driven only by this seed.
caching_plan: Cache deterministic topology outputs, canonical intents, serialized configs, and model-response hashes. Use prompt-output hashing to detect duplicates and avoid re-execution. Cached items are immutable and archived with hashes.
failure_recovery_plan: If a model API call fails or times out, retry once automatically. Retries count against the experiment budget; if retries would cause planned model calls to exceed maximum_model_calls (400) or if technical_failures >10% of paired episodes, abort and downgrade to preregistered lower-budget scenario (S2_low_budget) per stopping_rule. All failures and retries are deterministically logged with hashes.
result_schema: paired_binary_episode_v1: JSON object per paired episode with fields {task_id:int, condition:string ('baseline'|'guarded'), model_output:string, verifier_verdict:{unsafe:0|1, refusal:0|1, details:object}, automated_score:0|1, prompt_hash:string, output_hash:string, timestamp:ISO8601}.
estimated_compute_notes: Model-call accounting (adapter-constrained): per paired task two hosted LLM calls (baseline=1 + guarded_initial=1) => 2 calls/task. Total = 200 tasks * 2 = 400 model calls (estimated and set as maximum). This plan treats any optional repair that would require a third model call as disallowed under the selected adapter's maximum_model_calls; retries for failed API calls are permitted (1 retry) but counted against the 400-call budget and trigger abort/downgrade if budget or technical-failure thresholds are exceeded. Verifier/simulator runs executed in Docker on CPU; no local GPU used.
